india.one_line: India calls for human oversight in AI conflict use at the UN, while business adoption and budget proposals advance.

themes.title: Businesses and startups adopt AI agents
themes.text: A KPMG-CII report shows 93 percent of Indian business leaders plan to adopt AI agents, and startup AidenAI raised $32 million to expand its enterprise platform. Meanwhile, a Systematix report notes that AI adoption will sustain IT services demand despite pressures on traditional labor models.

stories.headline: 93% of Indian business leaders plan to adopt AI agents, report says
Systematix report: AI adoption to sustain Indian IT services demand, labor models pressured
AidenAI raises $32M Series A to expand enterprise AI platform

themes.title: Nasscom proposes three-year AI budget scheme
themes.text: Nasscom recommended a three-year AI Services Transformation and Innovation Scheme in its pre-Budget submissions for 2027-28 to help IT firms commercialize AI products.

stories.headline: Nasscom proposes three-year AI scheme for Indian IT firms in Budget 2027-28

themes.title: India urges human oversight in conflict AI
themes.text: During a UN Security Council debate, India stressed the necessity of maintaining human oversight in the application of artificial intelligence during conflicts.

stories.headline: India stresses human oversight in AI use during conflicts at UN
